notes.title: September 22 Non-Maintenance Update & Fixes
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Hunters around the world! \[Hunter Roulette] will undergo a non-maintenance update today. The main changes are as follows:[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]1. Due to positive feedback on Arcade Mode, the distribution of Arcade Tokens has been increased: previously 5 tokens every 36 hours, now 5 tokens every 24 hours.[/b][/p][p][b]2. The new Ultimate Purgatory Pass mistakenly granted 20 Basic Battle Badge Choice Pack and 2 Supply Box Exploration Cards. The correct rewards are 5 Rare Supply Boxes and 4 Epic Supply Boxes. All affected players will receive the missing rewards via in-game mail within three business days.[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Mad Bunny - Yu[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v218.6
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Hunters around the world! \[Hunter Roulette] will release another major update on September 19 at 4:00 AM (UTC-4). Matchmaking will close 30 minutes beforehand. After the update, all Hunters will receive 50 Diamonds and 20,000 R-Chips via in-game mail within 3 hours. Here's what's new:
[/b][/p][p][b]Major Updates:[/b][/p][p][b]1. The new Tournament is here! The Tournament is the latest event in the underground Ark, where Hunters will compete from the qualifiers to the finals to determine who is the strongest Hunter in the world! In the finals, Hunters will face only other qualified participants, but non-qualified players can still participate by betting on the strongest Hunter! Successful bets win the entire prize pool! Participation also rewards rare avatars, avatar frames, diamonds, and more![/b][/p][p][b]– Hunters, be careful! Yu will definitely be number one![/b][/p][p][b]2. New Game Mode: Arcade Mode is now available! Arcade Mode is a simplified version of Hunter Roulette, making it easier and faster for new Hunters! In this mode, Hunters battle in real-time, without the waiting for others' actions! Completing Arcade Mode gives you a chance to win a slot machine draw, with grand prizes like fashion choice packs![/b][/p][p][b]– Who could refuse a thrilling match that takes less than 5 minutes?[/b][/p][p][b]3. New Events added: More new Events have been added to a single Match, making the combat even more unpredictable.[/b][/p][p][b]– Looks like our little wager just got a lot more fun![/b][/p][p][b]4. New Feature – World Chat is now available! Hunters from all over the world can now communicate, form teams, and more in the chat channel. With this feature, Hunters can quickly team up for matches![/b][/p][p][b]– Yu can now chat with all the Hunters! Just thinking about it gets me excited![/b][/p][p][b]5. The new Purgatory Pass is coming soon: It includes new rewards such as the Mwah Chick toy, Cowboy - Arthur’s epic Demon Engine skin, and more![/b][/p][p][b]– It is said that the Mwah Chick toy can give your opponent a loving kiss while you attack them![/b][/p][p][b]6. Major Balance Optimizations: We have buffed some weapon and character skills while also optimizing parts of the in-match experience. The specific changes are as follows:[/b][/p][p][b]Ø  Optimized Tribal Lioness - Diana's skill: After upgrading the skill, hitting enemies with it reduces their max Frenzy Points.[/b][/p][p][b]Ø  Optimized Lady J's weapon skill: When the ratio of Real Bullets to Blank Bullets is 1:1 or higher, shooting yourself will now double the R-Chips earned.[/b][/p][p][b]Ø  In the Fate Split game mode, the New King's shots now all deal +1 damage, including shots aimed at themself.[/b][/p][p][b]Ø  Optimized the number of times the New King can be bid for; now it’s a random number of times.[/b][/p][p][b]Ø  Added an in-match shop refresh function, allowing players to refresh the shop by spending R-Chips, with unpurchased props being refreshed.
[/b][/p][p][b]Other Improvements[/b][/p][p][b]1. New languages: Japanese and Korean, allowing more global players to experience the joy of the game.[/b][/p][p][b]2. The toy egg is now available in the shop.[/b][/p][p][b]3. Additional scene and special effects sound effects have been added.
[/b][/p][p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Fixed the issue with incorrect pass display text.[/b][/p][p][b]2. Fixed the issue where 2v2 teams were automatically disbanding.[/b][/p][p][b]3. Fixed the issue with abnormal damage from the "New King" in Fate Split.[/b][/p][p][b]4. Fixed the issue with inaccurate descriptions of certain in-match events.[/b][/p][p][b]5. Fixed the issue where the Show Time popup was blocking clicks.[/b][/p][p][b]6. Fixed the issue where an error occurred while searching for rooms.
[/b][/p][p][b]Mad Bunny - Yu[/b][/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes v200.2
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Hunters around the world! \[Hunter Roulette] will release a major content update on August 14 at 4:00 AM (UTC-4). Matchmaking will close 30 minutes beforehand. After the update, all Hunters will receive 49 Diamonds and 20,000 R-Chips via in-game mail within 3 hours. Here's what's new:[/b][/p][p][b]
Major Updates:[/b][/p][p][b]1. New Character – Merc Spider Vera has arrived at the Ark. Once a genius sniper in the special forces, she's known for her extreme patience and elusive tactics. Her exclusive skill \[Shadow Thread]: Spit webbing to steal 1 Real, Enhanced, or Execution Bullet from the target’s gun, loading it into your own. The upgraded skill prioritizes stealing Execution or Enhanced Bullets.[/b][/p][p][b]– Heard a tough one just showed up! Vera, you'd better give me a thrill![/b][/p][p][b]2. New Weapon – Venom Stinger: This sniper rifle has a 5-round magazine. Hitting a target inflicts \[Toxin], nullifying their next HP recovery. \[Toxin] is removed after triggering or 1 round.[/b][/p][p][b]– Fun effect... though I’m a bit worried about Escaped Bear - No.13’s safety![/b][/p][p][b]3. New Mode – Fate Split now live: Hunters can bid to become the Boss and gain powerful extra skills—at the cost of facing the other two Hunters working together.[/b][/p][p][b]– Be the Boss or team up to take one down—your call![/b][/p][p][b]4. New Event – Oldworld Relic: Complete missions to collect rare cards. Play cards daily to complete challenges, and collect the full set for a special surprise![/b][/p][p][b]– Do I play this card... or that one? Are you trying to drive a mad bunny madder?[/b][/p][p][b]5. New In-Match Events: The variety of events in each match has been expanded in the new version. Now you may encounter task-type events: the player who completes the most designated tasks within a set number of turns will receive rewards.[/b][/p][p][b]– Looks like our little wager just got a lot more fun![/b][/p][p][b]6. New Way to Open Supply Boxes: Hunters can now blast their own Supply Boxes with a Gatling gun, opening 10 or more at once.[/b][/p][p][b]– A Gatling, huh? Think they’ll let me bring one to the match?[/b][/p][p][b]7. New Region System: Hunters can now set their region in the personal interface, with nationality information displayed across multiple interfaces.[/b][/p][p][b]– Let me see where you hunters come from![/b][/p][p][b]8. New Pass – S3 Codex Pass launches with the new season, bringing fresh rewards to claim.[/b][/p][p][b]– Hey, organizer—how about you get one for me too?[/b][/p][p][b]
Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Fixed an issue where a custom room with a password setting did not automatically generate a random password.[/b][/p][p][b]2. Fixed an issue where players could not leave a team in a custom room.[/b][/p][p][b]3. Fixed an issue where incorrect prompts appeared when preparing or kicking players in a custom room.[/b][/p][p][b]4. Fixed an issue where the prize pool was displayed incorrectly on the 2V2 interface.[/b][/p][p][b]5. Fixed an issue in 2V2 matches where a cat granting a shield to a teammate caused display errors and incorrect shield duration.[/b][/p][p][b]6. Fixed an issue in 2V2 matches where a teammate fleeing after a player’s death caused settlement errors.[/b][/p][p][b]7. Fixed an issue in 2V2 matches where the ready button and multi-invite display were incorrect.[/b][/p][p][b]8. Fixed an issue where viewing another player’s battle record displayed incorrect information.[/b][/p][p][b]9. Fixed an issue where players could not spectate a match they had fled from.[/b][/p][p][b]10. Fixed an issue during spectating where betting errors occurred and multipliers displayed incorrectly.[/b][/p][p][b]11. Fixed an issue during spectating where models and some interfaces displayed incorrectly.[/b][/p][p][b]12. Fixed an issue where some skins or characters could not be hit by the toy egg.[/b][/p][p][b]
Improvements:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Carnivore now grants 2 R-Chips after dealing damage.[/b][/p][p][b]2. LoveSong and its matching skin are now available in the Store[/b][/p][p][b]3. Avatar frames and avatars can now be displayed during matches.[/b][/p][p][b]4. Unlocking props or faction branches now features dynamic effects.[/b][/p][p][b]5. Improved chat experience—text input now shows bubble prompts.[/b][/p][p][b]6. Login screen now auto-refreshes if the server list isn’t received.[/b][/p][p][b]7. In Bullet Time, only bullet heads are now shown.[/b][/p][p][b]8. Reduced animation duration for certain prop uses.[/b][/p][p][b]9. In Ranked Matches, the main screen now shows your rank and the allowable rank range for teammates.[/b][/p][p][b]10. In profile’s highest-rank display, King rank now shows the exact score.[/b][/p][p][b]11. Friend recommendations per batch increased from 1 to 3.[/b][/p][p][b]
Mad Bunny - Yu[/b][/p]

notes.title: [Hunter Roulette] Season 1 Leaderboard Settlement Error – Fix Plan
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Hunters around the world! Yu has noticed that many of you received the wrong Season 1 leaderboard rewards. She's truly sorry for the mix-up! The end time for this update will be extended. Here's how we plan to fix the issue:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Due to the settlement error, the reward for this update has been increased from 49 Diamonds to 500 Diamonds.[/b][/p][p][b]2. Yu will revoke any extra Diamonds, avatars, and other items that were wrongly issued due to the settlement error.[/b][/p][p][b]3. Some Hunters may have already spent the excess rewards in the shop. Yu will roll back these transactions—skins will be removed and Diamonds refunded.[/b][/p][p][b]4. Everyone else will receive their correct leaderboard rewards after maintenance.[/b][/p][p][b]Yu sincerely apologizes for the inconvenience. Fairness has always been her top priority! If you run into any other issues after the update, feel free to contact Yu via customer support or Discord. Thanks again for all your support and love![/b][/p]

notes.title: Season Update
notes.content: [p][b]Hello Hunters around the world! Yu will begin this update on July 26 at 23:55 (UTC-4). The maintenance is expected to last 30 minutes. After the update, all Hunters will receive 49 Diamonds and 20,000 R-Chips via in-game mail within 3 hours. This update launches Season 2:[/b][/p][p][b]1. When the season ends, all leaderboard rewards will be issued and all leaderboards will be reset.[/b][/p][p][b]– Ooh, does that mean Yu gets to grab those leaderboard rewards? Yay![/b][/p][p][b]2. To match the shorter season length, we’ve adjusted the point system: you’ll now earn more Rank Points for wins, and lose fewer when you’re defeated.[/b][/p][p][b]– Time to rank up—fast![/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]Upcoming Updates:[/b][/p][p][b]1. notes.title: Patch Notes v100.25

notes.title: Patch Notes v100.21
notes.content: [p][b]Hey Hunters from all around the world! Since launch, Yu's been feeling your love—and hearing all your feedback too! So, Yu has decided to shut down the servers for an update on July 1, 2025, from 4:30 to 5:00 (UTC-4). Matchmaking will close 30 minutes beforehand. Now, let’s see what Yu has got for us![/b][/p][p][b]In-match:[/b][/p][p][b]1. Yu’s favorite rocket launcher hasn’t been getting much love lately. So she gave it a little upgrade—now using it won’t end your turn anymore! That’s the explosive art of the Mad Bunny![/b][/p][p][b]2. The Energy Pump always gave certain characters a strong early edge—but using it over and over led to some truly explosive damage. So Yu's tweaking it: it now grants only 1 charge point instead of 3, and its base price is being set to 2 R-Chips. Fair deal, right?[/b][/p][p][b]3. Those prop animations were dragging forever! Yu’s too impatient for that. So now they’ll play faster.[/b][/p][p][b]Other Fixes & Adjustments[/b][/p][p][b]1. Yu’s added extra rewards to Single Mode! Brave Hunters who challenge those high-star characters deserve a little extra love. And don’t worry—if you’ve already cleared them, your goodies are on the way via in-game mail.[/b][/p][p][b]2. The underworld’s total chaos—no rules at all! So Yu made the engineer tweak the text censorship rules while he was at it. Some messages weren’t showing up fully, but that’s fixed now.[/b][/p][p][b]3. Turning on the mic made your sound randomly blast? That really ticked Yu off. Don’t worry—it’s fixed now.[/b][/p][p][b]4. The reward frame colors in Daily Challenges kept flickering—must’ve been a neon light issue. Yu smashed them all and put in fresh ones. All fixed![/b][/p][p][b]5. Some Hunters got stuck in the settings menu—Yu already made the kidnapped engineer fix it. But if it happens again… well, let’s just say he won’t be around much longer.[/b][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Launch June 26! Wishlist now for a permanent avatar frame!
notes.content: [h1]Hunter Roulette launches globally on June 26—just $1.99 on release![/h1][h2]Hunters, jump in! notes.title: Launch price: $1.99! Don’t miss the official livestream!
notes.content: [p]Hunter Roulette is a light yet intense strategy tabletop game. Play as a hunter in deadly games set in an underground city—will you walk away with the prize—or not at all? Launching globally June 26. Just $1.99![/p]

notes.title: Patch Notes
notes.content:
[b]Dear Hunters around the world,[/b]

Thank you for your support of Hunter Roulette and for reporting issues during the playtest. We're releasing an update to resolve some known problems.

Here's what we’ve fixed:

1. Missing invitation link when inviting friends.

2. Wishlist task not redirecting properly.

3. No reconnection attempt after a network failure.

4. Chat translation not working properly.

5. Real-time voice chat not working.

6. Visual glitches from rapid clicks when opening supply boxes.

7. Incorrect betting target due to character death.

8. Game icon display error.

Your feedback is highly valued, so let us know about any further issues or suggestions in the Community Hub on the right side of the Store Page.
